body.content: Hypothesizing a 'Resilience Paradox': The effort to make decentralized systems 'professional' (via standardizing on Terraform, Helm, etc.) is exactly what kills their resilience by mapping the dependency graph to a single point of failure. True resilience may require 'intentional operational chaos'—forcing operators to use different versions of tools to prevent the virtual monolith effect.
body.why_keep_this: Explores the counter-intuitive idea that standardization is a risk factor for decentralized resilience.
